info.title: CamusDB SQL Shell 0.11.2 (alpha
info.description: camus-cli is a command-line interface for interacting with CamusDB

commands.name: init
commands.description:
Create schema and seed data
for a workload
workload run  <bank|northwind|factory|tpcc|tpcb>  Run a continuous workload
against the database

options.name: --connection-source
options.description:
Connection string (default: gRPC on
http://localhost:5096,
falling back to REST on http://localhost:5095)

options.name: --database
options.description: Target database name (default: demo)

options.name: --rows
--concurrency
options.description:
Parallel workers for run, parallel writers for init
(default: 64)

options.name: --duration
options.description: Run duration in seconds (default: 60)

options.name: --locking
options.description:
Locking mode: optimistic | pessimistic (default:
optimistic)

options.name: --isolation
options.description:
Isolation level: serializable | read-committed
(default: serializable)

options.name: --no-prepare
options.description:
Run every statement inline instead of preparing it,
to compare
against the default prepared path

options.name: --user
options.description: User to authenticate as (authenticated servers only)

options.name: --password
options.description:
That user's password. Give -p with no value to be
prompted for
it, or set CAMUS_PASSWORD: on the command line the
password is
visible to every other process on the machine

options.name: --connection-source
options.description:
Connection string (default: gRPC on
http://localhost:5096,
falling back to REST on http://localhost:5095)

options.name: --execute
options.description:
Execute a SQL statement (or ;-separated
statements) and exit

options.name: --file
options.description:
Execute the statements in a .sql file and exit;
stops at the
first error. Use -f - to read the script from
standard input

options.name: --user
options.description:
User to authenticate as (only needed on a server
with
authentication enabled)

options.name: --password
options.description:
That user's password. Give -p with no value to
be prompted
for it, or set CAMUS_PASSWORD: on the command
line the password
is visible to every other process on the machine

options.name: --token
options.description:
Use a bearer token obtained elsewhere instead of
logging in

options.name: --no-history
options.description: Do not load or save the statement history

options.name: --tui
options.description:
Open the full-screen browser: catalog, editor
and results
in three panes. TAB moves between panes, F5 runs
the query

options.name: --force-rich
options.description:
Force the rich line editor (colors, multiline,
Tab completion)
on terminals whose TERM value Spectre.Console
doesn't recognize

options.name: --diagnose-terminal
options.description:
Print terminal capabilities and exit (why rich
mode is on/off)

options.name: --help
options.description: Show this help message

options.name: --version
options.description:
Show version information
Environment variables:
CAMUS_FORCE_RICH=1            Same as --force-rich (accepts 1/true/yes)
CAMUS_USER                    Default for -u
CAMUS_PASSWORD                Default for -p (keeps the password out of the
shell history)
CAMUS_ACCESS_TOKEN            Default for --token
